label: Presenting problem and timeline
description: Clarify the concern, onset, course, triggers, and functional impact.

label: Depressive symptoms
description: Review mood, interest, energy, concentration, appetite, guilt, and psychomotor change.

label: Anxiety symptoms
description: Review worry, panic, avoidance, somatic anxiety, and situational triggers.

label: Current and past mania or hypomania
description: Review current and prior periods of elevated or irritable mood, reduced sleep need, speech or activity change, and impulsivity.

label: Psychotic symptoms
description: Review hallucinations, delusional ideas, paranoia, and thought disorganization.

label: Suicide and self-harm assessment
description: Assess ideation, intent, planning, behavior, protective factors, and access to means.

label: Existing safety plan and crisis supports
description: Review any existing safety plan, crisis contacts, support people, and access to the plan.

label: Violence risk assessment
description: Assess violent ideation, intent, recent behavior, access to weapons, and protective factors.

label: Medication reconciliation
description: Verify current prescriptions, nonprescription products, timing, prescribers, and changes.

label: Allergies and adverse reactions
description: Review reported allergies, intolerances, and prior adverse reactions.

label: Medication adherence
description: Review missed doses, interruptions, double doses, access, and administration routine.

label: Prior medication trials
description: Review prior medications, response, tolerability, duration, and reason for stopping.

label: Full psychiatric treatment history
description: Review medication trials, psychotherapy, current treatment providers, and prior levels of care.

label: Medication effects and adverse effects
description: Review perceived benefit, new symptoms, adverse effects, and their timing.

label: Substance use history
description: Review alcohol, nicotine, cannabis, stimulants, opioids, sedatives, caffeine, and withdrawal.

label: Sleep history
description: Review schedule, duration, sleep need, insomnia, daytime sleepiness, and sleep-related symptoms.

label: Family psychiatric history
description: Review psychiatric illness, substance use, suicide, treatment response, and relevant medical history in relatives.

label: Trauma history
description: Review potentially traumatic experiences and current trauma-related symptoms.

label: Collateral interview
description: Obtain observations from an available support person with appropriate permission.

label: Outside records
description: Request relevant prior notes, medication lists, test results, and discharge records.

label: Mental status examination
description: Assess appearance, behavior, speech, mood, affect, thought, perception, cognition, insight, and judgment.

label: General physical examination
description: Perform a general medical examination relevant to the presentation.

label: Weight, BMI, and body habitus
description: Measure weight and BMI and document observed body habitus.

label: Neurologic examination
description: Assess cranial nerves, motor function, sensation, coordination, reflexes, and gait.

label: Movement examination
description: Observe gait, tremor, rigidity, involuntary movement, restlessness, and ability to remain seated.

label: Orthostatic vital signs
description: Measure blood pressure and pulse after position changes and ask about symptoms.

label: Complete blood count
description: Obtain hemoglobin, hematocrit, white-cell indices, and platelets.

label: Comprehensive metabolic panel
description: Obtain electrolytes, glucose, kidney markers, calcium, proteins, and liver-associated tests.

label: Thyroid-stimulating hormone
description: Measure thyroid-stimulating hormone.

label: Vitamin B12 and folate
description: Measure vitamin B12 and folate status.

label: Hemoglobin A1c
description: Measure longer-term glycemic status.

label: Lipid panel
description: Measure total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and triglycerides.

label: Pregnancy test
description: Obtain urine or serum pregnancy testing.

label: Urine toxicology
description: Obtain the available urine toxicology panel.

label: Therapeutic medication level
description: Obtain a serum medication concentration for an applicable monitored medication.

label: Pharmacogenomic panel
description: Obtain the clinic's available pharmacogenomic medication panel.

label: 12-lead ECG
description: Obtain a standard 12-lead electrocardiogram.

label: Head CT
description: Obtain noncontrast computed tomography of the head.

label: Brain MRI
description: Obtain magnetic resonance imaging of the brain.

label: EEG
description: Obtain a routine electroencephalogram.
